context: Mature open-grown oasis or orchard date palm; single-stemmed, not a suckering offshoot clump or dwarf cultivar.

required_capabilities.rationale: Capability assessment 2026-09-19. The palm needs a stem (woody-axes) plus five named organs or attachments the habit, element and canopy tables do not already produce: an apical frond rosette, a pinnate frond, acanthophylls, persistent leaf bases, and an infructescence. Unbranched stem and near-constant trunk diameter are reachable values (habit.lateral_orders=0, radii.length_taper=0) and are not named here. See packet/capability.json.
